items.title: 68099_Erskine Hawkins oral history interview
items.q: We had Jackie "Moms" Mabley, the Steppe Brothers. We don't know nothing about show music, but we, they taught us.

ctx.x: So, we went in there, and had never played a stage show before. We had Jackie "Moms" Mabley, the Steppe Brothers. We don't know nothing about show music, but we, they taught us. And, Christina Banks and the chorus line.
I'd like to stay before 'Bama State, you know, for a little while. We're gonna get right to that a little later.
